newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Army chief says Israel won't shun using tanks.
newsitem.headline: Army chief says Israel won't shun using tanks.

text.p: Israeli army chief Amnon Shahak said on Friday that Israel would use tanks if necessary in a wave of violence that has engulfed the West Bank, Gaza Strip and Jerusalem.

"In some of the places there are tanks and armoured personnel carriers and where it is necessary we will use them. I can only hope we won't have to but if they force us we will use them as necessary," Lieutenant-General Shahak told a news conference in Jerusalem.
